summary: Explains string tests match (from the start), search (anywhere) and regex (like search by default, configurable with match_type), all with optional ignorecase and multiline.
questions: How do I check if a string matches a regex in a when condition?
What's the difference between match and search tests?
How do I do a case-insensitive string test?

answer_card.title: Testing strings with match, search and regex
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
when: url is match("https://example.com/users/.*/resources")   # from start
when: url is search("users/.*/resources/.*")                    # anywhere
when: url is regex("example\\.com/\\w+/foo")                    # like search by default
```

`regex` accepts `match_type` to choose the `re` method. All accept `ignorecase` and `multiline`.
